CORRECTION 2026-10-21: the figure first recorded here (108 ok, 0 FAIL, 12 skip, read as never having refused) was WRONG. The step line format is REFUSE, not FAIL, and the filter could not see the word. Re-counted over the same logs: 108 ok, 13 skip, 3 REFUSE, and 10 REFUSE lines in a looser pass; the fixer measured 15 in its own corpus. So the step does catch under-scoped closures locally and the ruling cost side is not zero. Recommendation on record: keep the skip as the default and force the local check with PREPR_RECORD_CLOSURES=1 on diffs touching tests/closures.json, tests/closure.py, or adding a read of an INERT file - the class that actually refused. Same change makes closures_line reap its recorder on TERM: stopped preprs left derive_closures reparented to launchd for 20-38 min. Fixer on handoff/r10-prepr-closures.
